name: JBHaMqttDiscovery
description: Home Assistant MQTT device discovery for ESP8266 and ESP32: sensors, binary sensors, switches, buttons, numbers, selects, texts, lights and covers, with commands, availability and auto-reconnect. Works with espMqttClient, PubSubClient and AsyncMqttClient.
keywords: home assistant, homeassistant, mqtt, discovery, autodiscovery, esp8266, esp32, iot
